descriptions.text: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an outdoor pool, and an indoor pool. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge).

Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Dunes Cafe, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee.

Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

Make yourself at home in one of the 302 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls.

activities.activityName: Private Sunrise Desert Safari Abu Dhabi
activities.description:
The magical sight of first light hitting the Abu Dhabi desert floor creating mesmerizing scenery hued with yellow gold light is a rare sight only a few get to experience in their lifetime. Join our sunrise morning desert safari in Abu Dhabi and capture the most beautiful sunrise you’ll ever see in your lifetime.

Picking you up from your location this morning desert safari in Abu Dhabi will take you into the desert in early in the morning. Once you reach the desert camp, find a good spot on the summit of a tall sand dune to witness the golden dawn in Abu Dhabi. Enjoy the golden rays of the sun the desert floor slowly vanishing the darkness filled the desert with yellowish-golden light. Feel the refreshing air of the morning enjoying a new day at the heart of the desert.

To add more adventure and excitement to your morning desert safari in Abu Dhabi, go on a dune bashing on a land cruiser riding over sand dunes.

Visit the camel farm
Visit the Traditional Arabic Camp
Sand boarding & skiing
Water and Soft Drinks

Transport in 4x4 vehicle
Dune bashing session

itineraryItems.description: Our tour guide will meet you at the hotel between 4.30-5.00 am in a Land Cruiser and drive you to the desert at the right time to witness the first rays of sunlight reach every nook of the desert.
itineraryItems.name: Abu Dhabi

itineraryItems.description: The early morning skies of the desert put on a colorful show with hues of orange, yellow, and red lighting up the area. So, visiting Abu Dhabi's desert at the time of sunrise allows you to take beautiful photos with your loved ones as well. It isn't just that. You can also go dune bashing on a Land Cruiser over mighty sand dunes to add adventure and excitement to your desert tour. If you are looking for other experiences to make the most out of your trip, you can even try riding camels in the desert. These camel rides are generally short, but you can go on multiple rides to extend your camel ride duration. However, if you are looking for a proper camel trekking experience, then we recommend you book our camel trekking tour. Additionally, you can also try quad biking for an additional charge.
itineraryItems.name: Al Khatim

itineraryItems.description: Get ready for your Half day desert safari Dubai as our guide picks you from your selected location or hotel. Board our 4WD vehicle that will take you to the desert. Once you reach the Lahbab desert, be welcomed into an air-conditioned tent with refreshments (Arabic tea/coffee with dates) take a small break for 20-25 minutes, make use of restroom, or even opt for a quad bike drive, while your vehicle ready for the off-road drive with adjusted tyre pressures.
itineraryItems.name: Dubai

itineraryItems.description:
Next, seat comfortably for the dune bashing session. Enjoy the rhythm of the vehicle riding over the sand dunes and feel the adrenaline rush! After around 30-45 minutes of dune bashing, click as many photos you want and relax for some time before you proceed for sand surfing (sandboarding). First, follow the instructions of your guide before you climb up and down the sandbanks on your board. As you surf over the sands, you will find this quite funny and unique!

Next, stop for a camel ride in the open desert. Later, relax in an air-conditioned tent and enjoy soft drinks and Arabic tea or coffee with dates.
Finally our guide will drop you off at your preferred location or hotel.
itineraryItems.name: Dubai

additionalInfo.description: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

It is recommended not to eat 2-3 hours before the safari trip to avoid any vomiting / sickness during the dune bashing
It is not recommended to carry jewelry, expensive watches or cell phones as the phone signal is not working in the desert.

Your belongings are your own responsibility and OceanAir is not responsible for any lost belongings in during the trip and in case if we found any belongings we try our best to deliver to whom they belong to by your own expenses.

OceanAir Travels shall not be responsible for any kind of loss, accident, sickness or injury. It is advisable that the traveler should avail a travel health insurance as there can be chances of potential risks and hazards. Also, make sure they are mentally and physically able to participate.
Pickup will be within 45min prior your selected departure time. Please be ready at the hotel lobby on time
Kindly share your Whatsapp number for an easy communication during the pickup
We recommend you have international travel insurance as self-driving activities are prone to risk, leading to serious injury & is covered only by your insurance companies.
Quad biking is a self-driving activity to be taken at your own risk and the company’s insurance does not cover it.
Long clothes and jackets are recommended during winter

Pick-up timing is subject to change due to the emerging summer heat: 1 hour earlier in the morning and 1 hour later in the afternoon. A notification shall be sent in advance in the case of any change.
Everything listed in the Inclusions is part of the tour and is covered in the price. Quad biking is available if option selected.

By UAE law, pregnant ladies, anyone with back or neck pain, heart problems or other serious medical complaints and infants (under 3 years old) are not allowed during the dune bashing activity by car. (If this conditions are applicable to you, please contact our Consultant to customize your tour)

activities.activityName: Dubai Sky Views Observatory Ticket with Free Glass Slide + Photos
activities.description: Discover the Dubai Sky Views Observatory with its thrilling Glass Slide, a must-visit attraction offering a unique and exhilarating experience in the heart of Dubai. Located atop the Address Sky View Hotel, this tour combines the Observatory, Sky Slide, and Sky Edge Walk for an unforgettable adventure. With your standard Sky View Dubai ticket, you gain access to the Observatory, boasting mesmerizing views of Dubai, and the Sky Slide, a thrilling descent through a transparent glass tube from the 53rd to the 52nd level. Take in panoramic views of iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, and Sheikh Zayed Road as you capture stunning photos on the 25-meter-long glass walkway connecting the twin hotel towers. Don't miss the chance to ride the first-of-its-kind Glass Slide for an adrenaline rush like no other. Book your Dubai Sky Views tour today and prepare to be captivated by the city's breathtaking vistas and unmatched thrills.

inclusions.otherDescription: Get the most compelling views over Dubai’s skyline and beyond as you zoom up 219.5 meters high
Sky Views Dubai Entry Ticket

packageDetails.title: Dubai Sky Views Observatory Ticket with Free Glass Slide + Photos 10:00

itineraryItems.description:
The Dubai Sky Views tour is an absolute must-visit. Sky Views from Emaar, which is perched atop the Address Sky View Hotel, combines three thrilling activities—the Observatory, Sky Slide, and Sky Edge Walk—into one. The Observatory, which offers the most mesmerizing views of Dubai, is included in your standard Sky View Dubai ticket, as is access to the Sky Slide, which whisks you down from the 53rd level to the 52nd level through a completely transparent glass tube while ensuring the most fantastical views of the surroundings.
Take Pictures:

A 25-meter-long glass walkway connecting the towers of this twin hotel, which is located at a height of 219.5 meters, is the main attraction of the Observatory's two levels. It offers a fantastic vantage point from which to take in the magnificent cityscapes as well as an excellent location for taking photos that are ideal for your Social Platforms like Instagram and etc.

Yas Island in Abu Dhabi is a popular spot for thrill seekers. It now also caters to families with the addition of KidZania Abu Dhabi. This 60,000 sq. ft. facility is located in Yas Mall, adjacent to attractions like Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, Yas Waterworld, and Warner Bros. KidZania Abu Dhabi is the second KidZania location in the UAE, following the Dubai Mall.

KidZania is a theme park for kids aged 4 to 16 that offers real-life occupations and learning experiences with entertainment.

KidZania Abu Dhabi offers over 60 role-playing activities for kids, allowing them to experience their favorite professions in a miniature city. Kids can earn and spend KidZos, the park's currency, while enjoying their financial independence.

While parents or adults aren't allowed inside the facility, electronic wristbands connect them with their children and trained supervisors are available to help kids navigate the miniature city.

itineraryItems.description: The City tour of Abu Dhabi will start with visiting the biggest mosque of UAE and one of the largest mosques in the world ‘Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque’ popularly known as ‘The White Mosque’. It does not just stand out as the largest mosque in the world but the only one that captures a unique interaction between the Islamic world and world cultures. Built with a vision to incorporate the architectural styles from different Muslim civilizations and the mosque celebrates the cultural diversity of the world. There were Italian, British, Emirati architects who worked hard to design and construct an architectural masterpiece. The parts were from Turkey, Morocco, Pakistan, and Egypt among other Islamic countries, revealing a shining architectural marvel with an amazing capacity of 40,000 worshippers and visitors. The mosque was named after late the late president, His Highness Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan.
itineraryItems.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque Center

itineraryItems.description: The city tour will continue with a photo stop of Emirate Palace Hotel, the third most expensive hotel in the world which cost approximately 3 Billion us dollar to construct is one of the most luxurious hotels in the world.

itineraryItems.description: Drive through Al Bateen Area of Abu Dhabi, the area is home to the president Place, royal family palaces, high-rise Iconic hotels overlooking the Persian Gulf. The next stop will be Abu Dhabi Corniche the eight-kilometer stretch of perfectly shaped waterfront with children’s play area, beach, numerous cafés, and fine dining restaurants make one of the best places in Abu Dhabi for a day out.
itineraryItems.name: The Corniche

itineraryItems.description: ou will then move to the Heritage village of Abu Dhabi, where you will have the chance to experience the traditional aspects of the desert way of life. The complex includes all the elements of a traditional Emirati lifestyle: A fort that defends the invaders, a souk where the day to day trade of goats, camels, and other livelihood took place, A mosque which shows the religion of Islam plays a significant role in the lifestyle.
itineraryItems.name: Emirates Heritage Village

All visitors will have a chance to learn about the formation of Emirates and the system of governance in this country. Qasar Al Watan is not just a traditional Palace but a tribute to the Arabian heritage and artistry. The nation's palace was constructed over seven years, from 2010 to 2017. Qasar al Watan will be a memorable experience, and you will walk away with the feeling of visiting one of the most luxurious buildings ever seen.

itineraryItems.description:
Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, is home to some of the most beautiful monuments and buildings in the country. The latest addition to the city is the Qasr Al Watan. The presidential palace is also known as the newest cultural landmark of the Emirate city. Qasr Al Watan houses the offices of the President, Vice President, and Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi.

Qasr Al Watan is the epitome of beauty, grace, and marvelous architecture. You would get to visit the beautiful rooms of the palace including the library, the Great Hall, the Barza (the royal banquet), etc. You would also be able to attend interactive cultural exhibitions, view rare manuscripts and artifacts, and witness the contribution of Arabs in the fields of humanities, science, literature, and arts. The ticket also gives you the chance to explore the gorgeous gardens that flank the palace.
